body.name: Exact lock compiler
body.construction: The map \(\operatorname{LockCompile}\) retains from the supplied affine family its terminal state \(\rho\), displayed legal trace \(\pi\), represented coordinates \(\mathcal M,\mathcal G\), nested forests \(F'\subsetneq F\), common root set \(R_F\), and inherited terminal assignments. It applies rational row reduction to \(E_T\) and \(b_T\). When the augmented-rank test passes, it selects a rational \(q\in\ker(E_T)\) with \(b_Tq\neq0\), sets \(v=R_Tq\), and chooses a nonzero rational \(t\) with \(0<|t|<\delta\) inside the supplied exact positivity radius \(\delta\). It sets \(\mathbf M_0=\mathbf M(0)\) and \(\mathbf M_1=\mathbf M(t)\), expands their exact rational evaluation tables, and copies \(\rho,\pi,\mathcal M,\mathcal G,F,F'\), and \(R_F\), together with the inherited assignments, tables, and arithmetic trace, into \(\Gamma\).
